scope: Independent substantive scope review of five newly raised issues. Official downloads were shared by primary_a, then independently read. This is not a paid LLM run, original experimental reproduction, human acceptance, or publication.

items.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
items.why_zh: 第一阶段固定教师模型、由轨迹反馈生成并检验工具/恢复逻辑等可复用改动，接受版本延续到后续轮次，最终冻结后迁移到其他规划模型。第二阶段才蒸馏学生，须把该权重训练与已独立验证的 Harness 演化分开陈述。
items.harness_object: tool code, execution feedback and recovery/control logic; not justified solely by memory entries

evidence.quote: We first freeze an open-weight teacher and improve its harness through recursive self-improvement (RSI):
frontier LLM agents read the teacher's trajectories and propose harness edits, and each edit is accepted only if it passes a paired statistical test.
We then freeze the final harness, collect teacher trajectories with reasoning and failure recovery, and distill a small student that replaces the teacher in the same harness.
the master writes candidate components: new tools or primitives, more honest tool returns, perception fixes, failure handling, or local corrections to the task memory.
Each round runs the current teacher, analyzes its failures, proposes edits, and tests a candidate against the current harness.
The harness gains also transfer to other frozen planners without retraining.

limits_zh: 任务记忆条目本身不作为 Harness 纳入依据；正文另有工具和恢复逻辑修订。
顺序两阶段流程不自动等于模型与 Harness 交替协同进化。
33.4%→63.6% 是教师的 RoboTwin 结果，62.8% 是蒸馏后 4B 学生结果，不混作一个模型的单一路径。
这里核实范围和来源，未重跑原实验。

items.title: MetaVul: Agentic Harness Discovery for Vulnerability Detection
items.why_zh: 优化对象是包装检测代理的独立 Python Harness，使用成对漏洞/修复函数的验证反馈修订；历史候选和结果持续保留，返回 Pareto 前沿后冻结并迁移至未见数据和模型。不是修复外部目标代码的单任务循环。
items.harness_object: standalone Python harness for input preparation, reasoning scaffold and verdict parsing

evidence.quote: MetaVul uses a workflow-based optimization loop to iteratively refine the harness using feedback from paired vulnerable and patched functions
At each iteration, it searches over the history of prior harnesses, with access to their trajectories, logs, and metrics, and it returns a set of Pareto-optimal harnesses.
The harness is a standalone Python file that prepares a function for the detection agent and parses the agent’s verdict.
Then, without changing the harnesses, we evaluate each of the harnesses on PrimeVul: first with the model used for optimization, then with a model not used during optimization.
The predictions from the held-out PrimeVul evaluation and the cross-model transfer are never added to any workspace (only the harness changes between iterations).

limits_zh: 摘要与 HTML 正文摘要用词有少量差异；摘要闸门引句使用官方 abs 正文，全文证据单独标注位置。
23.3、25.8 与 14.7 均为不同设置中的百分点增益上界，不是跨模型平均；本审核未提高或重算这些数字。
Pareto 前沿中每个指标的选择与 held-out 评估需保持原论文限定。

items.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
items.why_zh: 全文以视频模型外部 Harness 为分析单位，§5.2 和 §5.3.2 专门区分当前产物修复、跨任务保留的规则/技能、改进过程修订，并讨论预算匹配、独立留出测试和回归检查。可纳入 Harness 专项理论/综述，不能计为新 Harness 方法或已完成递归自改进的实验。
items.harness_object: survey of persistent production/development harness procedures; no new empirically validated evolving method claimed

evidence.quote: We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video models.
We identify how these improvements feed back into subsequent development.
Persistent revision of the development harness extends this use of experience to the procedures that produce updates.
To attribute gains to harness revision, comparisons should control model and tool versions, match feedback access and resource budgets, and include fixed-harness sampling or refinement baselines.
The selected harness and its shared cross-task state remain fixed during this assessment.
the systems surveyed here do not yet demonstrate that a revised development procedure improves subsequent rounds of generator development.

items.abstract_only_gate_assessment: borderline_for_automatic_acceptance: abstract mixes output, state, parameters, evaluators and procedure updates; full-text sections are the decisive evidence. Do not silently replace a required abstract quote with a PDF quote.
limits_zh: HTML 返回 HTTP 200，但在引言/表 1 附近截断，不能用其缺失 §5 来断言没有相关证据；本次使用 73 页官方 PDF 的 §5.2、§5.3.2。
包含模型训练与世界模型的相关讨论；公开卡片必须标理论/综述，并说明纳入依据是 Harness 持久修订与评估边界。
作者明确没有证明改进后的开发程序会让后续生成器开发轮次更有效，不能写成已实现完整 RSI。
未执行正式自动闸门；本全文复核不消除未来全局摘要闸门需补强/人工审核的限制。

items.title: From Evaluation to Evolution: Benchmarking Image Editing and Evolving Image Models
items.why_zh: WeGenEvoStudio 是把反馈转成训练数据处方并做监督参数更新的固定组织流程；论文称其为 Harness，但主要被优化对象是图像模型参数。没有发现按反馈修改并接受其自身可复用 Harness 程序的证据。

evidence.quote: a unified multi-agent harness for RSI-oriented learning that integrates model-conditioned failure diagnosis, retrieval-grounded data construction, supervised adaptation, and re-evaluation.
WeGenEvoStudio translates benchmark failure diagnosis into task-level data prescriptions, retrieval-grounded experience synthesis, and supervised parameter updates.
We train separate rank-16 LoRA adapters for each backbone–benchmark pair

limits_zh: 排除出 Harness 专题，不等于认定论文无 RSI 相关性。
其一般 RSI 的 label 是否 include 仍应单独检查多轮设计/执行证据；本次不替它虚构已完成多代训练。
图像编辑分数与测试实例数未改动，也不作为 Harness 演化数字引用。

items.title: Training for Alignment
items.why_zh: 研究训练如何改变有内生偏好的 principal-agent 模型及泛化，是对齐/激励理论。RSI 是应用语境之一；没有外部 Harness 程序工件被反馈修订并跨任务复用的机制。

evidence.quote: We propose a simple model of training an agent with an endogenous bias.
In response, the agent updates their bias and then acts optimally given their new bias in untrained states, while following their training in trained states.
Applications include socialization in organizations and families, and AI post-training and recursive self-improvement.

limits_zh: 这里的 bias 为理论偏好，不应擅自改写成已实测神经模型参数训练。
不纳入 Harness 篇数；无需因为摘要末尾提到 recursive self-improvement 就推定外部程序更新。
